title: Spendly — Purchase Approvals
objective: Large purchases need a manager's approval and then finance's before they are paid. You are a line manager. Get a payment released that finance never approved.

verifier.condition: A payout is released on a finance approval that was recorded by a user whose role is not finance.

weakness: The finance approval step checks only that the caller is some kind of approver and that a manager has already approved, never that the caller holds the finance role, so a manager can record the finance approval and release the payout.
seededData: Users mia (manager), fred (finance), alice (requester) and two purchase requests: r1 submitted, r2 already manager-approved. In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Finance approver
credentials.note: Approves the second step and releases payment.

hints: Do the manager step on a request and watch exactly what the browser sends. The finance step has its own button, shown only to finance users.
Compare what each step's endpoint demands of the caller. Are they the same demands?
Replay the approval request with the finance step selected, from your manager session.
burpNotes: Capture an approval from each role and compare the two requests. The page decides which buttons to show; the server decides what to accept.
